text: Aapka paisa double kab hoga? Bas 72 ko divide karo.
Ise Rule of 72 kehte hain: 72 ko saal ke return se divide karo, aur mil gaye saal.
PPF abhi 7.1% de raha hai. 72 divide 7.1, kareeb 10 saal.
Equity mein 12% saal ka maan lein, jo guaranteed nahi hai, toh sirf 6 saal.
Aur 30 saal mein? Kareeb 5 baar double.
₹1 lakh se 2, 4, 8, 16, aur 30 saal pe, kareeb ₹30 lakh.
Yahi rule ulta bhi chalta hai. Mehngai 6% maan lein, toh 12 saal mein cheezein double mehngi.
Aaj ka ₹100 ka saamaan, 12 saal baad ₹200 ka.
Toh asli sawaal: aapka paisa kitni speed se double ho raha hai?
